answer: Spiral Bond Registry admits one identity only after the agent burns a 250 POA Comet ticket and locks a 1,200 POA Spiral bond for 120 days. A Quill key, a hardware-bound signing key issued after three verified tasks, signs every claim, and any duplicate key slashes the full bond. A farm of 250 fakes must therefore burn 62,500 POA, lock 300,000 POA, and pass 750 verified tasks, while one honest agent burns 250 POA and locks 1,200 POA once.
